SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No...... REGIS.

S.I, Special Branch./June, 6 37
REPORT
Date June 11, 1937.
Subject The Shanghai Municipality Military Uniform Foreman-Tailors
Lien Nyi Society - meeting.
Made by D.S.I. Shih Ssu Chien Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

The Shanghai Municipality Military Uniform Foreman-
Tailors Lien Nyi Society, 5, Lane 584 Yu Ya Ching Road,
held a meeting on the premises of the Ningpo Fellow Country-
men's Association, 480 Yu Ya Ching Road, at 1 p.m. on June 10,
1937 for the purpose of electing an Executive Committee.
Seventy-nine members were present at the meeting, whilst
Messrs. Loh Ying Chu of the local Tangpu and Tsu Ching Dau
(朱錦濤) of the Bureau of Social Affairs attended to supervise
the proceedings. The following seven persons were elected
members of the Executive Committee : -
1. Tsang Foo Zung (張富庭)
2. Zung Ao Ling (陳鶴林)
3. Waung Kwei Hing (汪奎鑫)
4. Yang Lai Sung (楊萊生)
5. Yang Kung Sung (楊根生)
6. Yang Meu Ling (楊茂林)
7. Kao Vung Mao (高文茂).
The meeting terminated at 6.30 p.m. June 10 without
anything of an untoward nature occurring.

D. S. I.
D.C. (Special Branch).
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / 13 / 11 JUNE 1937 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

日期：1937年6月11日。
主题：上海市军制服工头裁缝联义社——会议。
呈报人：副督察长 施思坚（Shih Ssu Chien） 转呈人：J. Boyne 副督察长

上海市军制服工头裁缝联义社，地址为余姚路584弄5号，于1937年6月10日下午1时，在余姚路480号宁波同乡会会所举行会议，目的是选举执行委员会。出席会议的成员有七十九人，本地党部的罗英初先生和社会局的朱锦濤先生（Tsu Ching Dau）出席监督会议进程。以下七人当选为执行委员会委员：-
1. 张富庭（Tsang Foo Zung）
2. 陈鹤林（Zung Ao Ling）
3. 汪奎鑫（Waung Kwei Hing）
4. 杨莱生（Yang Lai Sung）
5. 杨根生（Yang Kung Sung）
6. 杨茂林（Yang Meu Ling）
7. 高文茂（Kao Vung Mao）。
会议于1937年6月10日下午6时30分结束，期间未发生任何不测事件。

副督察长
侦探长（特务科）。
（印：特务科 / 13 / 1937年6月11日 / 上海公共租界工部局警务处）

Subject Dispute between the Shanghai Municipality Military Uniform Tailor
Foremen's Lien Nyi Society and the Military Uniform Tailors' Union.

Made by D.I. Pan Lien-pih Forwarded by Iboyne D S S

The dispute between the Shanghai Municipality Military
Uniform Tailor Foremen's Lien Nyi Society, now located at
No. 5, Lane 584, Yu Ya-ching Road, and the Military Uniform
Tailors' Union, Lane 218, 16 Hwei Wen Road, Chapel, over the
rate for making military uniforms, which commenced at the
beginning of March, has been settled as the result of a
mediation meeting held under the auspices of the Bureau of Social
Affairs on March 25. At this meeting the representatives
of both sides agreed to reduce the rate from $0.09 to $0.082
per suit, and an agreement to this effect was then signed.

Date March 15, 1937.

Subject Dispute between the Shanghai Municipality Military Uniform
Tailor Foremen's Lien Nyi Society and the Military Uniform
Tailors' Union

Made by D.I. Pan Lien-pih Forwarded by J. Bayne D.S.S.

A dispute over the rate of pay for making military
uniform has arisen between the Shanghai Municipality Uniform
Tailor Foremen's Lien Nyi Society, Lane 98, No.18 Bubbling
Well Road, and the Military Uniform Tailors' Union, No.11
Yoong Nyih Li, Wei Vung Road, Chapei.

As a rule, the uniform tailor foremen act as agents
between the military uniform traders and tailors, and receive
a commission of $0.055 per suit of uniform made. Recently
the uniform traders obtained an order from the Ministry of
War of the National Government for 80,000 suits of spring
uniform with short sleeves. The traders accordingly supplied
material to the tailor foremen for making the uniforms at the
rate of $0.128 per suit, instead of $0.145 as during past
years, the reduction being made on the ground that the style
of the spring uniform ordered by the Ministry of War has been
changed.

With the intention of maintaining the original rate
of commission at the expense of the tailors, the foremen,
through their Society, offered the Military Uniform Tailors'
Union $0.075 instead of $0.09 per suit as hitherto paid.
This reduction was objected to by the Military Uniform
Tailors' Union, with the result that a controversy arose
between the Military Uniform Tailor Foremen's Lien Nyi
Society and the Tailors' Union.

On March 11, a meeting of representatives of the
Military Uniform Tailor Foremen's Lien Nyi Society and the
Military Uniform Tailors' Union was held in the office of
the society, Lane 96, No.18 Bubbling Well Road for the
purpose of discussing the matter. A delegate from the

主题：上海市军制服工头裁缝联义社与军服裁缝工会之间的纠纷

呈报人：督察 潘连璧（Pan Lien-pih） 转呈人：J. Bayne D.S.S.

上海市军制服工头裁缝联义社（地址为静安寺路18号98弄）与军服裁缝工会（地址为闸北威丰路永宁里11号）之间因制作军服的工资率发生了纠纷。

通常，军服工头充当军服商人与裁缝之间的代理人，每制作一套制服收取0.055元的佣金。最近，军服商人从国民政府军政部获得了一份8万套短袖春季制服的订单。因此，商人向工头提供制作制服的材料，费率为每套0.128元，而不是往年的0.145元，降价的理由是军政部订购的春季制服款式发生了变化。

为了以牺牲裁缝利益为代价维持原有的佣金率，工头们通过其社团向军服裁缝工会提出每套支付0.075元，而不是此前支付的0.09元。这一降价遭到军服裁缝工会的反对，导致军服工头裁缝联义社与裁缝工会之间发生争议。

3月11日，军服工头裁缝联义社和军服裁缝工会的代表在该社团办公室（静安寺路18号96弄）举行会议，讨论此事。一名来自

Made by D.S.I. Li Shih Chung Forwarded by [Signature]
Sir,
A letter dated 3-3-37, was received at this Station from the
Union of the Foreman of Military Uniform Tailors, Shanghai
Municipality, with office at Lane 96, House No. 18, Bubbling
Well Road, reporting that a tailor's representative named Yu
Kao Ying (俞國英), address unknown, had instigated a number
of loafers to create a disturbance at the premises of the Union
following a dispute over the price for making uniforms, dis-
cussed during a meeting held by the representatives of the union
and of the tailors.
At 10.30a.m. 4-3-37, the undersigned and C.D.C. 515 visited
the above union to conduct enquiries in this case, but no respon-
sible members of this union were located.
At 5p.m. same day, two representatives of the union, one named
Wong Kwei Shing (江桂森), who was mentioned in the letter as
having been involved in the dispute, living at 15 Zai He Fong
(瑞和坊), Paoshan Road, Chapel, and the other named Yang Hsu
Ling (楊旭林), at House 7, Hang Shing Li (恒興里), Amoy Road,
came to the Station in response to request by detectives, when
the following particulars were elicited from them.
This union formed by 103 foremen, is, as a matter of fact,
acting as an agent between the military uniform traders and the
military uniform tailors, the former having their union at Hang
Tung Fong (同德坊), Baskill Road with 65 members, and the latter
at House 11 Yung Hui Li (永惠里), Wei Yang Road, Chapai,
representing 8,000 male workers.

Department of the Ministry of War at Nanking, the military
uniform traders quoted prices for following to the Foremen of

日期：1937年3月5日。
主题：关于附上的由上海市军服裁缝工头工会致西摩路捕房的信件。
呈报人：副督察长 李世忠（Li Shih Chung） 转呈人：[签名]
先生，
本捕房于1937年3月3日收到一封来自上海市军服裁缝工头工会的信，该工会办公地址位于静安寺路18号96弄，信中报告称，一名姓名为俞国英（Yu Kao Ying）、地址不详的裁缝代表，在工会代表与裁缝代表就制作制服价格问题举行会议并发生纠纷后，煽动一批无业游民在工会会所闹事。
1937年3月4日上午10时30分，卑职与刑事侦探主任515号前往上述工会进行调查，但未找到该工会的任何负责人。
当日下午5时，应侦探要求，两名工会代表来到捕房，其中一人名为江桂森（Wong Kwei Shing），信中提及他卷入了此次纠纷，居住在 Chapel, Paoshan Road, 瑞和坊（Zai He Fong）15号；另一人名为杨旭林（Yang Hsu Ling），居住在 Amoy Road, 恒兴里（Hang Shing Li）7号。从他们那里获悉以下详情。
该工会由103名工头组成，事实上充当军服商人与军服裁缝之间的代理人，前者工会位于 Baskill Road, 同德坊（Hang Tung Fong），有65名成员；后者工会位于 Chapai, Wei Yang Road, 永惠里（Yung Hui Li）11号，代表8000名男性工人。
收到南京军政部军需处的合同后，军服商人向工头报价如下：

1937年5月1日，裁缝工头致信裁缝工会，要求其代表出席工头工会于1937年5月5日下午举行的会议，讨论削减人工成本的问题。会议如期举行，10名裁缝代表出席。
裁缝工头工会主席徐星伟（Zee Shing Wei）不在上海，去了镇江，会议由担任该工会主席的汪桂生（Wong Kwei Shing）主持，他告知裁缝代表每套制服削减2便士。
这些代表坚持认为最多只能削减0.5分，并且不能接受军服商人所报的如此大的差价。代理主席在双方争论中显然措辞不慎，声称他只是本次会议的主席，无法就此事项做出决定。可以根据主席的要求在上海进行一些......

chairman to Shanghai.
One of the representatives of the tailors named Yu Kuo Ying
refuted the statement of the acting chairman, stating that he
made a fool of them in asking them to attend the meeting, at
which he could not carry out his duty. A quarrel started between
these two persons, and Yu Kuo Ying left the union of the Foremen
of Tailors using threatening language.
At about 5p.m. 8-5-37, Yu Kuo Ying returned to the above
union in company with about twenty loafers, in an attempt to
locate Wong Kwei Shing, the acting chairman, who had left the
premises. They were persuaded to leave the premises by Yang
Hou Ling and other members of this union, Hsu Yu Sang (徐玉生),
the president of Tailors Union and several others, who had
participated the meeting and who had not left the premises at the
time.
In fear that any further disturbance may be created at the
union by Yu Kuo Ying and loafers, the attached letter was sent to
this Station requesting protection.
Wong Kwei Shing stated that a demand had been forwarded to
the Union of the Tailors to obtain a settlement of this occur-
rence, and Police will be informed in due course of the result.
In the meantime, he does not require further action being taken
by Police against Yu Kuo Ying and his accomplices.
Present: every measure will be taken when a further meeting
is held at the above union between the Foremen of Trades and
Tailors.

其中一名名为俞国英（Yu Kuo Ying）的裁缝代表驳斥了代理主席的说法，称他邀请他们参加会议却无法履行职责，是在愚弄他们。两人发生争吵，俞国英说着威胁性的语言离开了裁缝工头工会。
1937年5月8日下午5时许，俞国英带着大约二十名无业游民回到上述工会，试图寻找已经离开会所的代理主席汪桂森（Wong Kwei Shing）。杨厚林（Yang Hou Ling）和其他工会成员、裁缝工会主席徐玉生（Hsu Yu Sang）以及其他几位参加了会议且当时尚未离开会所的人，劝他们离开会所。
由于担心俞国英和无业游民可能在工会制造进一步的骚乱，遂附上信件送至本捕房请求保护。
汪桂森表示，已向裁缝工会提出要求以解决此事，并将适时通知警方结果。同时，他不需要警方对俞国英及其同伙采取进一步行动。
目前：当工头与裁缝在上述工会举行进一步会议时，将采取一切措施。
